neighbours.label: Keyboard controls in game or program instructions: the keys you press (WASD, spacebar, TAB, 'q' to exit); doorbells, piano keys and bars stay low.
fire: Move your ship with the WASD keys and aim with the mouse.
Press the spacebar to fire and hold shift to run.
Hit TAB to switch weapons during a fight in the arena.
Press any key to restart ('x' to quit)...
Use the arrow keys to steer the car around the track.
To open your bag in the game, tap the I key on your keyboard.
Climb the ladder, then press the spacebar to leap across.
用方向键控制人物，空格键跳跃。
quiet: Move your car out of the drive and park by the mailbox.
Press the button to call the lift and hold the door open.
Hit the road early to avoid the traffic near the arena.
Call any time to reschedule your visit...
Use the side roads to reach the town around the lake.
To open your bag at the airport, ask the officer at the desk.
Climb the ladder, then paint the wall across from the window.
用筷子吃面条，用勺子喝汤。

notes: Probes: WASD 0.97, TAB through 0.46, 'q' to exit 0.47, spacebar 0.44, Chinese arrow keys 0.34; doorbell 0.06, piano keys under 0.01, bar 0.02.
